display.purpose: Part title on the stage bar.

headline.purpose: Section names in the library rail and parameter column.

body.purpose: Values, fields, list items, rule copy; tabular figures.

body-sm.purpose: Secondary lines beside a value: meta line, units, segmented and switch labels, rule lists, coupon note.

label.purpose: Uppercase inline labels for top-bar controls only.

shadows.name: ring-selected
shadows.purpose: Zero-blur amber ring on a selected library item; a stroke, not elevation. No blurred shadows exist.

motion.name: laser-reink
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: plate strokes re-ink and magnitude dots fade and shrink to 0.2 when Laser colours toggles.

breakpoints.name: compact-plate
breakpoints.purpose: Plate width below which rulers, leaders and the figure drop.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one chalk action per screen (Export).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 34px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); background: var(--chalk, #f2efe6); color: var(--navy, #0f1a33); font: 600 14px var(--font-sans), "Public Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #fff; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber, #e8a24a); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: var(--line, #22325a); color: var(--mute, #8e98b3); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Link Button
components.css: .ds-link { background: none; border: 0; color: var(--amber, #e8a24a); font: 400 14px var(--font-sans), "Public Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 6px 4px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber, #e8a24a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Number Field
components.description: Parameter row with a right-aligned tabular number input.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 40px; width: 272px; color: var(--chalk-dim, #c9c6bd); font: 400 14px var(--font-sans), "Public Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-row small { color: var(--mute, #8e98b3); font-size: 12px; margin-left: 4px; } .ds-num { font: inherit; width: 72px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; text-align: right; color: var(--chalk, #f2efe6); background: var(--navy-2, #13203d); border: 1px solid var(--line, #22325a); border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); caret-color: var(--amber, #e8a24a); } .ds-num:hover { border-color: var(--grid, #5a6f99); } .ds-num:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber, #e8a24a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--line, #22325a); border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); overflow: hidden; } .ds-seg button { height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--text-2, #b3b8c6); font: 400 13px var(--font-sans), "Public Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button + button { border-left: 1px solid var(--line, #22325a); } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--navy-2, #13203d); color: var(--chalk, #f2efe6); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber, #e8a24a); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Laser Colours Switch
components.description: Toggles the plate re-ink into cut-layer preview colours.
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 400 13px var(--font-sans), "Public Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--text-2, #b3b8c6); cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 1px; height: 1px; } .ds-switch span { width: 30px; height: 18px; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--line, #22325a); position: relative; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-switch span::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 3px; top: 3px; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--mute, #8e98b3); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-switch input:checked + span { background: rgba(232, 162, 74, 0.35); } .ds-switch input:checked + span::after { transform: translateX(12px); background: var(--amber, #e8a24a); } .ds-switch input:focus-visible + span { outline: 2px solid var(--amber, #e8a24a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Library Item
components.description: Element picker rows in the left rail.
components.css: .ds-lib { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 208px; } .ds-lib button { width: 100%; height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; background: none; color: var(--chalk-dim, #c9c6bd); font: 400 14px var(--font-sans), "Public Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-lib button:hover { background: var(--navy-2, #13203d); color: var(--chalk, #f2efe6); } .ds-lib button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--navy-2, #13203d); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--amber, #e8a24a); color: var(--chalk, #f2efe6); } .ds-lib button span { font-size: 12px; color: var(--mute, #8e98b3); } .ds-lib button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber, #e8a24a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Rule Status
components.description: Pass/fail lamp; failures state the problem plus the remedy.
components.html:
Export blocked1 / 2

  • Only 1.60 mm of material between holes; Acrylic 3 mm needs 2 mm. To fix: use the checker pattern, or pick a material with a smaller minimum web.
components.css: .ds-status { padding-top: 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #22325a); font: 400 14px var(--font-sans), "Public Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--chalk, #f2efe6); max-width: 272px; } .ds-status p { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin: 0; } .ds-status i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--amber, #e8a24a); outline: 1px solid var(--amber, #e8a24a); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-status small { margin-left: auto; color: var(--mute, #8e98b3); font-size: 12px; } .ds-status.bad i { background: var(--err, #ef6a60); outline-color: var(--err, #ef6a60); } .ds-status.bad p { color: var(--err, #ef6a60); font-weight: 500; } .ds-status ul { margin: 10px 0 0; padding: 0 0 0 18px; color: var(--chalk-dim, #c9c6bd); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Chart Plate
components.description: Star-atlas plate: pitch grid, chalk outline, magnitude dots sized by hole diameter, amber dimension.
components.css: .ds-plate { width: 360px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #22325a); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--field, #0c1630); padding: 12px; } .ds-plate svg { display: block; width: 100%; } .ds-plate .g { stroke: var(--grid, #5a6f99); stroke-width: 0.6px; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; opacity: 0.45; fill: none; } .ds-plate .o { fill: rgba(242, 239, 230, 0.04); stroke: var(--chalk, #f2efe6); stroke-width: 1.4px; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; } .ds-plate .h circle { fill: none; stroke: var(--chalk, #f2efe6); stroke-width: 1.4px; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; } .ds-plate .m circle { fill: var(--chalk, #f2efe6); } .ds-plate .d { stroke: var(--amber, #e8a24a); stroke-width: 1px; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; fill: none; } .ds-plate text { fill: var(--amber, #e8a24a); font: 400 2.2px var(--font-sans), "Public Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
The kit is charted like a sky. Every surface sits on chart navy, and the chart plate is the light source: parts are plotted in chalk, holes are magnitude dots, the outline is the line joining them, and Athena Ergane's owl, patron of craftspeople, is engraved faintly beneath the field the way a star atlas sets its constellation figure under the stars. Dark is a world choice, not a theme toggle.

The system is an operating tool for makers standing next to a laser. Density is moderate and steady: a fixed shell of hairline-divided columns, tabular figures for every value, and annotation in red-flashlight amber so the numbers read like a chart's measurements. Ornament lives only in the plate; the shell around it stays quiet. What the screen plots is what the laser cuts, in real millimetres.

The world refuses the grey CAD inspector with a white canvas.
keyCharacteristics: Chart navy ground across shell and work area; chalk for parts and text.
Flashlight amber for annotation, selection and focus; red only for failed rules.
Spectral light italic names things; Public Sans with tabular figures carries every value.
Hairline borders, 6 px radii, no drop shadows.
One authored motion: the Laser colours re-ink.

rules.name: The Machine Truth Rule
rules.body: Export colours are pure #FF0000 / #00FF00 / #0000FF and are never themed, tinted or adjusted. The screen shows lightened stand-ins only when Laser colours is on; the file always carries the pure values.

rules.name: The Red Means Fault Rule
rules.body: Fault Red appears only when a rule fails. It is never decoration, never a hover, never an accent.

rules.name: The One Flashlight Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only accent. Selection, focus and annotation share it; nothing else competes.

rules.name: The Two Hands Rule
rules.body: Spectral italic names; Public Sans measures. A value is never set in Spectral, except the italic hole-diameter callout on the plate.

rules.name: The Eleven Pixel Floor
rules.body: Plate annotations never render below 11 CSS px. The annotation unit grows with the fitted scale until labels reach that size.

rules.name: The Flat Chart Rule
rules.body: No blurred shadows. Separation is a hairline or a tonal step, never a lift.

dos: **Do** keep export layer colours pure #FF0000 / #00FF00 / #0000FF; preview with #ff6a5c / #4fdc8c / #8fa8ff only under the Laser colours switch.
**Do** hold plate annotations at 11 CSS px or larger; below a 560px plate, drop rulers, leaders and the figure rather than shrink type.
**Do** draw failing webs on the plot in Fault Red, not only in the side panel.
**Do** size magnitude dots from the hole diameter (dot radius = 0.5 of hole radius).
**Do** write rule copy as the problem plus the remedy: what is short, by how much, and what to change ("To fix: ...").
**Do** set every value in Public Sans with tabular figures and its unit in Mute.
**Do** keep the owl figure a faint hairline engraving (0.09 opacity) anchored to the plate.
donts: **Don't** add blurred or offset shadows; separate with hairlines and tonal steps.
**Don't** theme, tint or restyle the exported file's colours.
**Don't** use Fault Red for anything but a failed rule.
**Don't** add a second accent colour or a second animated moment beside the Laser colours re-ink.
**Don't** show the owl figure on the coupon or a compact plate, or raise it above a faint underlay.
**Don't** put the screen on a white or grey canvas; the plate is chart navy.
